name: Metallic Triangle Bikini (signature-colour underlayer)
description: only a {{PRIMARY}} string bikini, top and bottom both in a lustrous satin-metallic finish with a subtle {{METAL}} sheen and a hairline {{METAL}} edge trim: a top of two small triangles, just large enough to cover, joined at the centre front by a thin string that draws them close together so the bust is lifted and pressed into a deep, tight cleavage, tied with thin string straps at the neck and the back; and a matching bottom of a small triangle at the front and a narrow triangle at the back, joined by thin string ties at the hips - thin strings only, no bands, no wide waistband, no thick sides; midriff, abdomen, and hips bare; matching {{PRIMARY}} open-toed high heels with {{METAL}} accents
notes: Each sister's art.defaultUnderlayer: the signature primary colour with a subtle metal sheen, so it pops on the A-pose and carries into outfits. Override with components.underlayer (e.g. the plain triangle-bikini) to dial it down.
